title: youtab.scope-placement.v1
description: Machine-readable interface request (item 8): a Gateway/Workspace-Authority-signed placement token that cryptographically binds the memory scope dimensions absent from the base BrainCommandEnvelope. Until a token of this shape is verifiable by the Runtime, LIVE multi-tenant/workspace memory stays DISABLED and admission-supplied values NEVER authorize retrieval or persistence.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm; Runtime enforces an allowlist (ed25519 only).

command_id.description: Binds this placement to the BrainCommandEnvelope it accompanies.

run_id.description: The Durable-Execution run/task id (may equal task_id).

delegation_authority_ref.description: Reference to the delegation/authority grant that authorizes this principal+agent to act in this workspace.

expires_at.description: Placement is rejected at/after this instant (stale-token fail-closed).

key_id.description: Gateway signing key id for rotation.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload (excluding signature), verifiable with the Gateway public key. Same discipline as BrainCommandEnvelope.verify().

x-runtime-requirements.canonical_serialization: JSON of all fields EXCEPT signature, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators (',',':') — identical to BrainCommandEnvelope.canonical_payload().
x-runtime-requirements.verification: PlacementVerifier.verify (youtab_runtime/memory/placement.py) checks algorithm allowlist, issuer, issued_at<=now<expires_at, cross-checks command_id/trace_id/tenant_id/principal_id against the BrainCommandEnvelope, verifies the Ed25519 signature with the Gateway public key for key_id, and rejects a replayed (tenant_id, nonce). Only then does it emit a VerifiedPlacement.
x-runtime-requirements.verification_result_type: VerifiedPlacement (verified=True literal). JSON-schema validation alone is NOT authorization; only a VerifiedPlacement may build a live MemoryScope. Runtime code must consume VerifiedPlacement, never a raw SignedScopePlacement.
x-runtime-requirements.fail_closed: If the token is absent, malformed, wrong-algorithm, wrong-issuer, expired, cross-tenant/principal/command/trace mismatched, replayed, or signed by an unknown key, verification raises PlacementError and the Runtime refuses LIVE retrieval/persistence. Admission-supplied unsigned values are for local single-principal operation only and never authorize server retrieval/persistence.
x-runtime-requirements.replay_cache: Runtime keeps a (tenant_id, nonce) replay cache; a durable cross-process cache is required for a live deployment.
x-runtime-requirements.key_rotation_revocation: key_id selects the Gateway public key; rotation adds a new key_id, revocation removes it from the Runtime key map (unknown key_id -> refused).
x-runtime-requirements.consumer: youtab_runtime.memory.placement.PlacementVerifier -> VerifiedPlacement -> MemoryScope; retrieval pipeline requires request.scope == verified.scope.
